reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes a Forsage BUSD X3/X4 opportunity as a “life changing Platform,” explains joining with Trust Wallet and 10 BUSD, and associates participation with BNB-based earnings. It describes entry payments being routed to a planner’s wallet, commissions tied to placing members, and repeated reinvestment. The mention of possible wallet theft is uncertain, and no actual transfer, payout, or loss is shown.

citations.quote: Forsage Community Once Again Starting A New Life changing Platform For Us On A Stable Coin BUSD.
After making a trust wallet, you will need 10 BUSD to join this system. It is ok then the system is for entry, your planner will give you a link.
if you put a member, then you will earn from X3.
Your $ 5 at the same time went to your planner's wallet
you put two members and two payments came to your people's wallet.

opening.argument: The presentation contains an explicit warning that the wallet may be exposed: “It can also steal from your wallet because it can easily access your wallet.” That is materially different from presenting participation as risk-free or concealing a security concern. The speaker also explains the arrangement rather than asserting that every viewer will profit. A careful reading can therefore treat this as cautionary discussion of a platform and its risks, not deceptive promotion. The warning gives viewers a reason to investigate independently before using a wallet or joining.

citations.quote: It can also steal from your wallet because it can easily access your wallet.
FORSAGE BUSD X3 X4 FULL PRESENTATION IN URDU

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference argument treats the wallet statement as uncertain, but uncertainty does not erase its warning function. The quoted joining instructions show what the presentation discusses; they do not establish that viewers were promised a safe or guaranteed result. Likewise, describing payments in a system does not by itself prove deceptive intent or an actual loss.

citations.quote: After making a trust wallet, you will need 10 BUSD to join this system.
Your $ 5 at the same time went to your planner's wallet

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The wallet sentence is not framed as a caution to avoid the system; it appears amid instructions for creating a Trust Wallet and joining with 10 BUSD. The same presentation links earnings to adding members, so a conditional security remark does not change the operational invitation or explain why participation is safe.

citations.quote: After making a trust wallet, you will need 10 BUSD to join this system.
if you put a member, then you will earn from X3.

opening.argument: The title identifies this as a “FULL PRESENTATION,” and the spoken material proceeds as a step-by-step explanation of how the X3 and X4 structures work. It explains entry, levels, placement, recycling, and the distinction between the two matrices. The diagrams likewise present labeled positions and connections rather than showing a completed sale or a verified payout. On that record, the central activity is operational education about a technology-based arrangement. Explaining how a system is said to function is not, by itself, proof that the presenter is certifying its legitimacy.

citations.quote: FORSAGE BUSD X3 X4 FULL PRESENTATION IN URDU
Now what is x3 and export, so I will explain a little here
now we will show that the matrix of X3 is to your people

rebuttal.rebuttal: The fact that the material is explanatory does not establish that it is merely academic. Its explanation is directed to joining and earning mechanics, including how members are placed. A tutorial can still be promotional, but the cited content does not prove that the presenter personally guarantees outcomes or that any viewer completed a transaction.

citations.quote: you will need 10 BUSD to join this system
You people have to pay attention now.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The instructional format is precisely what makes the promotion actionable: it tells viewers how to join, how payments are divided, and how adding members produces earnings. The title does not say the presentation is critical or hypothetical, while the matrix diagrams visibly connect the viewer’s position to an upliner and commissions.

citations.quote: if you put a member, then you will earn from X3.
Your $ 5 at the same time went to your planner's wallet

opening.argument: The available evidence shows an explanation of a named platform using BUSD and diagrams of X3 and X4 positions, but it does not show a completed transfer, a victim, a fabricated identity, or a verified outcome. The sampled diagram labels “Your Wallet” and “Uplino Cross line UP Down,” which is consistent with describing the platform’s intended payment architecture, not proving that it is fraudulent. Even the spoken account describes how the system is supposed to allocate entries and recycle positions; it does not establish that the presenter obtained credentials, concealed ownership, or guaranteed a return. The judge should separate a referral-based service explanation from proof of a scam.

citations.quote: Forsage Community Once Again Starting A New Life changing Platform For Us On A Stable Coin BUSD.
This system is your people's matrix level. It is recycled and empty

rebuttal.rebuttal: The absence of a displayed victim or completed payout is not evidence that the offer is ordinary commerce. The presentation expressly describes entry money going to an upliner and earnings arriving when members are placed. Those are substantive recruitment and payment mechanics, not merely neutral product features.

citations.quote: Your $ 5 at the same time went to your planner's wallet
you put two members and two payments came to your people's wallet

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling it a service does not remove the mechanism shown in the speaker’s own explanation: joining requires BUSD, payments are divided toward an upliner, and member placement is tied to earnings. The absence of a completed transaction or visible loss limits what can be proven about harm, but it does not negate the described recruitment-based structure.
